entries.description: Hardscrabble Hill Center is a retreat and educational center offering intensive residential courses and retreats for women, located in Orland, ME. It has 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild acres, housing, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, a bio-dynamic garden, and women living and working the land. It welcomes wild women and various workshop participants.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it describes itself around 'courses and retreats for women'. Accepted groups: non-lesbian women included via 'wild women', 'feminist journey'. Focuses: workshops/education from 'courses and retreats', farming/self-sufficiency and environmentalism from 'bio-dynamic garden'. Land location inferred as Orland, ME from the mailing address.

entries.description: Linda Tisdale and Carol Shoreborn host a 30-acre private land holding in Dexter, ME with 2 lesbians and 2 children. They offer camping space and primitive conditions, welcoming campers, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children by invitation only.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it lists individual names and states 'We are a small family'. Accepted groups: nonlesbian women, girl children, and boy children explicitly named. Focus on environmentalism from 'We do not smoke, drink, use drugs' and off-grid camping setup. Land location inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: Northwoods offers primitive camping and retreat/healing space on 143 acres mostly uphill in Alpine, NY. It features a sauna and ponds for swimming.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor' kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it says 'offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping'. Accepted groups: empty list since no specific welcome list is provided. Focus on environmentalism from 'Chemicals are discouraged'. Land location inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: Oneida Farm is a homestead in Dillsburg, PA (between Harrisburg and Gettysburg) on 20 acres with cows, chickens, bees, fruit trees, and a garden. Maintained by a homesteader who is a separatist, it welcomes non-lesbian women and offers a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, and pasture.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden. I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it uses first-person singular 'I am a homesteader'. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women explicitly welcomed. Focuses: farming/self-sufficiency from 'homesteader/farmer', environmentalism from 'No drugs...'. Wait, text says 'I am not a separatist', so no lesbian separatism focus. Land location inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: Heathcote Womens Community is a community and retreat center located 35 miles north of Baltimore in Freeland, MD. It has 35 acres of woods, meadow, and stream in a land trust, along with 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, and solar heat. It is home to 4 lesbians and welcomes visitors, new members, and children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it explicitly calls itself a 'wom'ns community' and has 'new members'. Accepted groups: non-lesbian women ('all women of all colours and persuasions'), girl children, boy children. Focuses: farming/self-sufficiency ('organic gardens, bees'), environmentalism ('wood and solar heat'), workshops/education ('developing the retreat center'). Land location inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: An unnamed community c/o Nan and Ruth with 20 acres located between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA (mailing address Unger, WV). It features a passive solar shell, electricity, camping space, and woods. It is home to 2 lesbians and welcomes non-lesbian wimmin, children, and males under specific conditions.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because they own land together, live there, and have members/residents goals. Accepted groups: non-lesbian women ('non-lesbian wimmin'), girl children, boy children, non-gay men ('males'). Focuses: farming/self-sufficiency ('small-scale farming'), environmentalism ('passive solar shell', 'No drugs'). Land location inferred from regional description and contact state.

entries.description: Moon Ridge is a wimmin's community in Guysville, OH on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. It features a house, barn, another house under construction, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, and farmland. It is home to 3 wimmin and welcomes wimmin and children for help with food and work exchange.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it's a group of wimmin living on land together ('We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres'). Accepted groups: non-lesbian women ('wimmin'), girl children, boy children ('children'). Focus: farming/self-sufficiency ('gardens', 'farmland', 'goats'). Land location inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: Whispering Winds is country living with privacy for womyn located in Northern Minnesota (Iron, MN) on 3+ acres with access to a small lake. It has 1 lesbian resident, a house, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, and woods, welcoming company of womyn of all ages.

Company of womyn of all ages welcomed. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods.
